# Components

What ReliKey composes. Each is an upstream image or binary pinned by version (and digest), configured only through its own documented interfaces (decision 0001).

## Core (once per organisation or site)

| id | component | version | licence | zone | role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| broker | Keycloak | 26.8.1 | Apache-2.0 | appliance | Identity broker. Holds credentials, passkeys and sessions; brokers to the organisation's IdP when there is one. |
| broker-db | Broker database | 16.8-alpine | PostgreSQL | appliance | Keycloak's PostgreSQL, in the core pod on loopback only; nothing else reads or writes it (decision 0015). |
| front | Front proxy | 2.11.7-alpine | Apache-2.0 | appliance | The core's one published port: terminates TLS and routes by hostname to the broker's sign-in, the desk, and an edge-facing name that serves only what an edge needs (the desk's edge routes and the mirror's read API); the broker's admin console only on a host-loopback listener. Holds the TLS key and no other secret (decision 0015). |
| clerk | KeyClerk | 0.26.3 | EUPL-1.2 | appliance | Governance engine. Decides who may reach what, until when, with whose second key; issues signed lease bundles. |
| vault | OpenBao |  |  | appliance | The organisation's own OpenBao or Vault, when it runs one, read by Warpgate's secret backend for target credentials; ReliKey ships none (decision 0012, R-01: gaps go upstream, not into a new component). |
| fleet | ReliKey fleet service |  |  | appliance | Fleet management, ReliKey's own (decision 0026): receives each edge's signed report (outbound from the edge, through the front's edge-facing name), keeps the inventory - last seen, release, applied serial, drift, attested profile, link crypto - serves the fleet view, and raises the silence alarm. Works with any clerk or none; a clerk adds its governance facts. Evidence and governance events only, never device telemetry (0021). |
| mirror | Update mirror | v2.1.22 | Apache-2.0 | appliance | The image registry mirror in the core that edges pull from, serving only digests named in a signed update manifest whose key is separate from the lease-signing key (decision 0009, RT-19). zot, syncing only the pinned digests; edges never pull from the internet (decision 0012, R-20). |

## Edge (next to the legacy system)

| id | component | version | licence | zone | role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| agent | ReliKey edge agent |  |  | appliance | Pulls signed lease bundles from KeyClerk (outbound only), verifies them, and applies them locally - Warpgate role assignments and session approvals, facade password rotation. Decides nothing KeyClerk did not sign. |
| bastion | Warpgate | 0.30.2 | Apache-2.0 | appliance | Protocol bastion for SSH, RDP, VNC, databases, Kubernetes and HTTPS targets; records every session. |
| proxy | Edge filtering proxy |  |  | appliance | Terminates TLS on the user HTTPS port and forwards everything except Warpgate's admin paths (under both /@warpgate and /_warpgate) to Warpgate on loopback; holds only the TLS certificate (decision 0008). Removed when Warpgate has a separate admin listener (U-08). |
| facade | LDAP facade | 0.6.3 | GPL-3.0 | appliance | The directory an LDAP-only system binds against; its passwords are lease credentials, never a person's own. |
| host | Edge host |  |  | appliance | The operating system and container runtime of the switch's app hosting or the small board; its own time source, name resolution and image pulls. Counted in the footprint, pinned by the deployment, not by ReliKey. |

## Outside ReliKey

| id | component | version | licence | zone | role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy | Encapsulated system |  |  | legacy | The system ReliKey wraps - a legacy application, hardware appliance or robot controller. Unchanged. |
| person | Person and device |  |  | user | A person with a phishing-resistant key (passkey) on their own device. |
| org-idp | Organisation identity provider |  |  | org | Optional upstream IdP the broker federates with (OIDC or SAML); its signals only tighten. |
| org-store | Organisation evidence store |  |  | org | Object storage and log receiver for session recordings and audit events. Required: recordings stream there and the agent backfills what the edge could not deliver (decision 0009). |
| org-escrow | Organisation escrow |  |  | org | The organisation's password manager holding break-glass values under dual control, as ciphertexts to two custodians (decision 0008); never paper. |
| org-time | Organisation time and name service |  |  | org | Authenticated time (NTS) and DNS the edge uses while online; offline the time rules of decision 0007 apply. |
